correctness.rationale: Carry pair equations and m^2≡1 modulo g yield unique low digits. A rigorously exhaustive high-digit interval permits four small candidate ranges. The excluded endpoints violate carry bounds. All sixteen edges, start transition, pivots, closure, and reachability are checked algebraically for every m≥3; verify.py independently tests all vertices and edge labels for m=3..100. No finite extrapolation is used.

originality.rationale: Kendrick explicitly formulates precisely this infinite graph-isomorphism as Conjecture 39. The new symbolic transition table proves it. Sloane supplies the graph formalism but no dominating theorem for this family. Actual database and literature searches uncovered unrelated graph-theoretic objects, not an equivalent proof. Later unindexed work remains a risk.
residual_risks: A post-2015 or unindexed solution using a different carry-automaton name might exist; absence of a database hit is not proof of novelty.
